podcast.body: Buddy Holly's first solo single, which was musically based on "Love Is Strange" by Mickey and Sylvia, a personal favorite of Holly's. Although not a hit for Holly himself, a cover version by The Diamonds reached number 13 on the charts even before Holly's original was released. "That song was based on Love Is Strange by Mickey and Sylvia, a favourite of Holly's."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode Sixty-One: "That'll Be the Day", by the Crickets
